description: This file is a shell script used as a part of Git's internationalization (i18n) system. It manages gettext settings, determines the gettext implementation scheme, and defines wrapper functions for translating strings within Git's shell environment.

methods.name: eval_gettext
methods.description: Function to evaluate gettext output by substituting environment variables and processing the translation string.

methods.name: gettextln
methods.description: Wrapper function that calls gettext and adds a newline.

methods.name: eval_gettextln
methods.description: Wrapper function that calls eval_gettext and adds a newline.
